name: Inchworm
summary: A segmented control whose selector is a little inchworm that arches its way to the range you pick
about: A Day, Week, Month and Year control above a garden water chart. The selector is a green inchworm: it looks and turns toward your pick, reaches forward and pulls its tail up in an arch once for every segment it crosses, then lands with a squash, a blink and a flick of leaves. Meanwhile the old bars sink and the new ones spring up in a stagger while the total counts to the new figure.
how: Click or tap a range, or Tab to the control and use the arrow keys, Home and End.
The worm looks your way, turns round if it has to and bunches up.
It reaches forward and arches its tail behind it, one step per segment, while the old bars sink.
On arrival it squashes, blinks and flicks off leaves; the new bars spring up one by one and a sprout marks the top bar.
The total counts to the new figure; at rest the worm breathes, its rings crawl and it blinks now and then.
